Welcome to SciStarter!

You are on your way to becoming a citizen scientist by doing REAL science in need of YOUR help!

Girl Scouts has teamed up with SciStarter to curate projects for girls, volunteers, and others to deepen their engagement in citizen science and explore outdoor STEM.
